question.question_text: What event immediately follows the camera wearer handling a USB connector?

answer_options.text: Tests the USB connector for functionality
Adjusts the camera on his head
Connects the USB connector to the system board
Secures the USB connector with screws

shared_investigation.established_facts: The video begins with the camera wearer handling a USB connector. No subsequent actions involving the USB connector are visible. The camera wearer is seen working on a disassembled laptop, adjusting internal components, and using a screwdriver. No USB-related actions are visible after the initial handling of the USB connector.
